title: A Border for the Cover
author: Coral Lockridge
blurb: Rafael Villalobos, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
